# `igdev gateway status`

status reports what the container engine says about this Instance's compose project
and the URL the Checkout Setup recorded, so an agent never has to read setup.json or
assume a port.

## Usage

```text
igdev gateway status [flags]
```

## Examples

```text
  igdev gateway status
  igdev gateway status --json
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help   help for status
```

## Global options

```text
      --config stringArray   override one config key for this run, key=value (highest precedence)
      --json                 emit the JSON envelope on stdout (machine mode)
```

## Agent usage

pass --json for the machine contract. data carries the address block plus
state (the compose project's overall verdict) and services, one entry per service with
name, service, state, and status as the container engine reports them, so an agent reads
the engine's own words instead of parsing human output.
